v: pu॰ gu--pinAkAditvAt Aka ni॰ dIrGaH । (supArI) kramuke amaraH “GoraRwaH pUgI pUgaSca gu(gU)vAkaH kramukI'sya tu । PalaM pUgIPalaM proklamudvegaYca tadIritam । pUgaNgaru himaM rUkzaM kazAyaM kaPapittajit । mohanaM dIpanaM rucyamAsyavErasyanASanam । ArdraM tadgurvaBizyanti bahnidfzwiharaM smftam । svinnaM dozatrayacCedi dfQamaDyaM taduttamam” BAvapa॰ । “praBAte pUgamaDikaM maDyAhne KadiraM taTA । niSAsu cUrRamaDikaM tAmbUle Bakzayet sadA” BAvapra॰ ।
m: गुवाक m. (Uṇ. iv, 15; = गूव्˚) the betel-nut tree, PSarv.
